en-US.author: David M. Anderson
en-US.description: Write ODT and DOCX from a docling DoclingDocument, in pure Rust
en-US.name: waddle
en-US.releaseNotes:
Security release: docling 2.65 and zip 9.1 fix GHSA-m665-v7pm-7grj (critical) and four high/medium advisories in archive reading (GHSA-9hj8-73fh-9963, GHSA-hjqx-j4rw-g7xv, GHSA-q7v9-x93c-xqv3, GHSA-8hxf-qr8p-62x4).
waddle-core now builds on docling-core 2.65, which it re-exports, so this is a minor version. A link whose Markdown destination carries a backslash escape, such as Albert\_Einstein, is written with the URL it means.
Full Changelog: v0.4.1...v0.5.0
